_about: Hybrid motor model spec (docs/hybrid-motor-model.md) for tools/flight_profile/hybrid_motor.py and its ports (GS backend/src/apogee_planner/hybrid.rs, FirmwareSimulator src/bay/hybrid_motor.rs). Geometry comes from the team's motor design preset (motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml); 'assumed' marks numbers Rylan should replace; grains holds the port geometries (the 2026-11-16 fire burned the cylindrical preset grain; the flight grain is a star whose dimensions are PLACEHOLDERS until Rylan gives them). 'calibrated' holds what hybrid_calibrate.py fitted to the accepted archive fires; it overrides the model priors. After editing: hybrid_calibrate.py, then hybrid_vectors.py, then copy to backend/src/apogee_planner/model/ and FirmwareSimulator.

tank_volume_l.source: measured: Rylan 2026-11-23, 967.45 in^3 (vehicle.json run_tank_volume_l); the preset tank (146.05 mm x 917.6 mm + 0.469 L closures) gives 15.84 L

tank_wall_kg.source: assumed: the Al 6061 wall share of the 8.6 kg tank estimate in vehicle.json (the preset leaves wall mass null)

valve_cd.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): valve discharge coefficient

valve_area_m2.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): valve effective area (in series with the injector, liquid phase)

injector_hole_d_m.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...) (plate 6.35 mm)

injector_cd.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...) calibration (prior); calibrated

throat_d_m.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): graphite throat (the optimiser candidate is 41.66 mm, eps 3.25)

exit_d_m.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): exit; eps 3.284

nozzle_half_angle_deg.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): diverging half angle 0.2269 rad

throat_erosion_m_per_s.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): throat_erosion_model none

paraffin_a.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...) calibration: regression_coefficient_si (r = a G^n, G in kg/m^2/s); for comparison the Stanford N2O lab-scale law is 1.55e-4 G^0.5

paraffin_n.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): regression_flux_exponent

abs_a.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): abs_regression_si

abs_n.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): abs_regression_si

tank_aft_from_nozzle_exit_m.source: assumed station for the CG output (SWEET_V6.ork has the tank and motor stations; not yet mapped)

grain_aft_from_nozzle_exit_m.source: assumed: nozzle + postchamber 168 mm (preset) + about 0.1 m

test_ambient_pa.source: assumed: static-fire site about 200 m MSL

eta_cstar.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): characteristic_velocity_efficiency 0.8 (prior); calibrated

eta_nozzle.source: divergence factor (1 + cos 13 deg)/2 of the preset nozzle (the preset itself uses 1.0)

wall_coupling.source: prior: share of the tank wall heat capacity that follows the fluid (the lumped equilibrium tank stands in for the preset non-equilibrium BDF tank, whose coefficients are null); calibrated to the tank pressure trace

fill_scale.source: N2O mass in the tank per kg of GS fill reading (KG50). Fixed at 1 in the default fit; the diagnostic fit frees it (the KG50 slope is unverified: 22 799 vs 12 915 kg/V, docs/loadcell-investigation-2026-11.md 2.2)

vapour_cd_scale.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): vapour-tail equivalent CdA 6.38e-5 m^2 (HEM, an uncalibrated prior) is about the liquid-path CdA, so the prior multiplier is 1; calibrated to the tail

regression_scale.source: multiplier on both regression laws; fitted only when a fire records the fuel burned (grain weighed before/after)

ignition_delay_s.source: 2026-10-31 chamber pressure rose 0.16 s after valve open; extract_thrust.py takes 0.1 s (the preset lightoff model is disabled)

end_dp_pa.source: burn ends when the tank is within 1 psi of ambient

max_burn_s.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): maximum_time_s

cylindrical_preset._about: The preset grain: a printed ABS gyroid matrix (with inner and outer walls) filled with paraffin, single circular port. The 2026-11-16 fire burned this grain.

grain_od_m.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...) (chamber ID 88.9 mm, liner 1.905 mm)

abs_rho.source: preset: motor_design/current_single_port_baseline.preset.yaml ("Current single-port motor baseline", fingerprint 19dab2f3...): grain_recipe abs_density

abs_profile.source: motors/sweet_v6_grain.json: ABS share vs radius from the voxelised print (hybrid_preset.py), scaled to the preset 0.188 kg of ABS

star_placeholder._about: PLACEHOLDER star port for the flight grain (the team is switching to a star grain; Rylan to supply the dimensions). Same length, OD and materials as the preset; 6 points with about the preset initial port area. Replace every value marked PLACEHOLDER.

star_root_radius_m.source: PLACEHOLDER: about the preset initial port area (2.03e-3 m^2) with the tip fillet

abs_profile.source: assumed: the same printed gyroid matrix, ABS share as a function of radius (the print field cannot be remapped to an unknown star print)

calibrated.note: written by hybrid_calibrate.py; the station refits stage 2 on its own archive (hybrid_fit.rs)
